name: campaign_summary
description: Aggregate feature-campaign usage/session data and final changed files without imposing an aggregate spend cap.

usage.description: Arbitrarily nested object/array of usage records to aggregate. Any dict containing tokenUsed/totalTokens/costUsd/totalCostUsd is treated as a record; nested containers are searched recursively.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repo checkout used to compute changed/uncommitted files.

baseCommit.description: Base git ref diffed against HEAD to compute committed changed files.

sessions.description: Map of task ID to session ID; when supplied, overrides the sessions list derived from usage records.

branch.description: Campaign branch name, echoed back and reused as verifiedBranch when outcome is 'verified'.

sourceRepoPath.description: Original source repo path, echoed back; defaults to repoPath when omitted.

inPlace.description: Whether the campaign ran in place on the source repo.

outcome.description: Final campaign outcome, echoed from input (defaults to 'incomplete').

branch.description: Campaign branch name, echoed from input.

verifiedBranch.description: Same as branch when outcome is 'verified', otherwise empty string.

repoPath.description: Repo path used, echoed from input.

sourceRepoPath.description: Original source repo path, echoed from input or defaulted to repoPath.

inPlace.description: Whether the campaign ran in place on the source repo.

changedFiles.description: Sorted union of files committed between baseCommit and HEAD, and files with uncommitted changes.

uncommittedFiles.description: Sorted list of paths with uncommitted changes.

totalTokens.description: Total LLM tokens summed across all discovered usage records.

totalCostUsd.description: Total USD cost summed across all discovered usage records, rounded to 6 decimals.

sessions.description: Map of task ID to session ID; taken from input.sessions when provided as an object, otherwise the list of session IDs found in usage records.
